global.currency: ISO-4217 caller supplied; engine performs no FX conversion
global.missingValueRule: Return NEEDS_INPUT for missing top-level required metadata or required calculator field; never impute numeric values.
global.jurisdictionRule: Jurisdiction is required only where the calculation enters jurisdiction-sensitive estate context; tax rules are not activated.
global.taxRule: No tax value is calculated without a separately governed jurisdiction-specific ruleset.
global.modelBoundary: LLM prose may explain engine output but cannot create numeric inputs, replace formulas, or override engine values.

CASH_FLOW.formula: surplus = income - expenses; savingsRatio = surplus / income

DEBT.formula: fixed-rate monthly amortization; payment must exceed monthly interest when rate > 0

SAVINGS.formula: required periodic contribution to reach caller-defined target over caller-defined horizon

RETIREMENT_SCENARIO.formula: monthly compounding with end-of-period contributions; optional inflation deflation to today's money
RETIREMENT_SCENARIO.boundary: scenario projection only; no guarantee or recommendation

DRAWDOWN.formula: monthly return then withdrawal, stopping at zero balance

AFFORDABILITY.formula: cash capacity and ratio arithmetic only; no PHI OS affordability threshold is invented
AFFORDABILITY.boundary: not a lending decision or recommendation

ESTATE_SUMMARY.formula: gross assets - liabilities before tax, fees, probate, trusts, or distribution
ESTATE_SUMMARY.boundary: no tax, legal validity, probate, beneficiary distribution, or executed-instrument conclusion

inputs.other: existing M4A-W2C v2 optional gap/ratio inputs

FINANCIAL_POSITION.formula: delegates to governed financial-calculation-layer.js without answer-prose composition
